Theme

grill noun and verb

also gridiron, barbecue, broil

classical

Traupman 71, 276
Traupman 324

crāticula, crāticulae f.

noun, first declension · Declension on Wiktionary

grill, gridiron

Other words

  • super crāticulam assāre — to grill, barbecue

    also used · modern · Traupman 71, 276; Traupman 324

  • torreō, torrēre, torruī, tostum — broil, roast, toast

    verb, second conjugation · also used · classical · Verg. A. 1.179: torrēre parant flammīs (Lewis & Short); Traupman 70 · Conjugation on Wiktionary

    Lewis & Short: “to dry a thing by heat, to parch, roast, bake”; so pānis tostus, toast.

Examples

  • rāra tibi curvā crāticula sūdet ofellā

    let the gridiron sizzle with a few chopsMart. 14.221.1

See also chop, roast.

SourcesLewis & Short: craticula · Lewis & Short: assus
